scalableSourcePatterns: Official venue menu pages and PDFs are the strongest source and preserve the venue's own serving-size and price rows.
Many Riga craft venues publish live Untappd venue pages; use only pages marked or linked as the venue and record retrieval dates because tap lists change frequently.
Official sites often embed current menu images in Wix or WordPress uploads; retain the image URL as evidence and manually review OCR rather than using delivery menus.
Use Wolt or Bolt only for venue or beer-name discovery. Their prices may be marked up and are not displayable venue prices without independent venue-menu confirmation.
When a current menu exposes an item but not a price or volume, keep it in an unpriced/missing list and do not infer a value.
